description: This file contains service functions for converting a Lead into Account, Contact, and Opportunity entities within a Django CRM application. It manages creation and data migration between models such as Lead, Account, Contact, and Opportunity, including copying related tags, comments, attachments, and linking contacts.

methods.name: convert_lead_to_account(lead_obj, request, create_opportunity=True)
methods.description: Converts a Lead object into an Account, Contact, and optionally an Opportunity, migrating related data such as comments, attachments, and tags, and establishing relationships between the new entities.
